summary: Gauzy Ltd, an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K furnishing a proxy statement for a Special General Meeting on August 31, 2026. Shareholders will vote on authorizing the board to effect one or more reverse share splits (1-for-2 to 1-for-1000) prior to December 31, 2027, and to amend articles to reduce authorized capital proportionally. The board unanimously recommends a FOR vote. The reverse split is a condition precedent to a proposed $7 million debt settlement and PIPE financing essential to continued operations and maintaining Nasdaq listing. This is a routine corporate-governance authorization, not a special situation; the meeting notice and proxy statement are standard filings.
